items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a: squash-vs-clamp affinity bounding-operator cap sweep with gain-matched control arm (diagnostic)
items.note: Validates mode-governance-engagement ITEM (1) (the affinity bounding operator) ONLY; items (2) commitment-term grading and (3) production default remain OPEN and are untouched. DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from confidence scoring). PROMOTES NOTHING -- MECH-266 / SD-032a pending_retest_after_substrate holds, and the Stage-H nav-competence dependency gating v3_exq_464d/467d is untouched. DESIGN: crosses the affinity bounding OPERATOR with the cap at EVAL time on clones of one trained curriculum agent per seed (cap, mode and sigma all read live at SalienceCoordinator.tick()). THREE bound arms x CAP_SWEEP [0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5,1.75] x 2 rail arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] = 30 cells/seed: clamp_baseline (w=3.0, the V3-EXQ-934 baseline design), squash (sigma=cap default), and clamp_gain_matched (clamp operator, w'(cap)=3.0*(cap/(cap+1))/min(1,cap)) -- the ATTRIBUTION CONTROL added by USER DECISION 2026-09-19T23:52:40Z OPTION A. Training held at cap 2.0 under the clamp (464e/934 construction). Seeds 42-44 kept deliberately (934's; its seed 44 guard-PASSED with the highest contact rate, 0.3064). LOAD-BEARING DV: occupancy -- the squash arm's ARM_SYMMETRIC gate via experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py, GRADED iff >=2 CONSECUTIVE cap values each mixed in (0.1,0.9) on >=2/3 seeds. Bar TRANSCRIBED from the entry's own failure_record target, never re-derived; gate called ONCE per (bound_arm, rail_arm) over ALL (seed,cap) cells with seed AND sweep_value populated -- NOT 934's per-seed call shape, which is what produced its false routing. The continuous margin is RECORDED AS TELEMETRY WITH NO THRESHOLD (user decision): no numeric threshold for the squash-vs-clamp contrast is registered anywhere. WHY THE THIRD ARM: red-team pass 1 (fable) returned BLOCKING, verified against source -- the operator is applied to EVERY affinity_weights signal (salience_coordinator.py:616-636) including the [0,1]-bounded external_task_drive (agent.py:2760-2765, w=3.0), and at sigma=cap the squash returns 0.500x AT the cap, so clamp->squash moved the external_task logit by -0.96..-1.50 while the dacc_pe degeneracy fix under test moved its logit by only -0.034..-0.173 (8x-28x confound). With two arms neither a PASS nor the null was attributable. GFLAG-0370 records this and also that the why_sigma_equals_cap rationale in the substrate entry does not hold as written. RED-TEAM pass 1 (fable): BLOCKING -> resolved by user OPTION A. RED-TEAM pass 2 (fable, licensed re-spawn since the manipulation changed): CONTESTED, 4 findings, ALL reproduced against source and FIXED -- (F1) the (squash NOT graded, gain_matched graded) cell was unrouted and recorded a false 'no_arm_graded' reason with SD-032a weakens, now its own branch -> gain/non_contributory; (F2) the gain match holds only at engagement e=1.0, so 'the control did not grade' could be over-cutting rather than gradedness -- a false-positive path to supports; cells now record REALIZED drive contribution under all three arm definitions and the gradedness attribution is gated on gain_match_valid (residual < the gain cut it reproduces; boundary definitional, not tuned); (F3) 'occupancy static across arms' was attributed to the item-(2) latch unconditionally, now requires et_sat_mean>0 since engagement near zero produces the same reading; (F4) INHERITED FROM V3-EXQ-934 -- the external_task_drive_engages precondition cannot see a dead drive: measured, with the drive signal at EXACTLY 0.0 the margin still reads 0.3287-0.4950, 6.6x-9.9x the 0.05 floor, because it is floored by external_task_bias=1.0; added external_task_drive_signal_nonzero (a zero-test on the drive's own value). F4 is worth governance attention on its own account. PAIRING: cells are RNG- AND ENV-paired across bound arms (per-cell seed derives from (seed,cap,rail_arm) only, driving reset_all_rng and a fresh per-cell env), bound arm nested INNERMOST -- fixes the vacuous 1e-6 non-degeneracy guard (banked 934 cells differing only in rails already differed by 1.7e-3) and the shared-stateful-env order confound. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = per-cap occupancy under salience_affinity_bound_mode='squash'; that mode landed 2026-09-19 and NO recorded manifest has ever set it (934/935/935a are all clamp-only), so the readout is absent from every banked run -> must run, not reanalyzable. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-266/SD-032a count=7 but RELEASED -- the named upstream substrate (mode-governance-engagement item (1), cingulate.salience_coordinator.affinity_bound_operator) shows IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-19 in ree-v3/CLAUDE.md; and this is a new EXQ number testing a different mechanism (the operator family) as a diagnostic discriminating WHY the ceiling holds, which Step 2.5b exempts independently. STEP 2.5c: no open 'corrupting' substrate_queue entry overlaps this driver's modules (mode-governance-engagement itself is severity=cosmetic). Runs under these open 'degrading' entries, recorded as known limitations: SD-018 and SD-106 (agent.py::compute_resource_proximity_loss, latent/stack.py), sd061-resume-progress-ecology (causal_grid_world.py::CausalGridWorldV2.step), SD-091 (agent.py::REEAgent.select_action), SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (config.py, causal_grid_world.py, agent.py), SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY (agent.py::REEAgent.sense). SMOKE: PASS (rc=0) -- 12 cells (3 arms x 2 caps x 2 rails), denominator ep N/45, 1 verdict line, gain-matched weights exact (1.714286 at cap 0.75, 1.5 at cap 1.0); a guard-passing run exercised the full analysis path and landed on the new F3 branch (et_drive_mean=0.7256, et_sat=0.0 -> static_but_latch_not_implicated, non_contributory), which pre-fix would have recorded SD-032a weakens against a latch that never fired. validate_experiments --strict: 38/38 OK. Successor to V3-EXQ-934; NOT a supersede -- 934 measured the clamp across the same band and that reading stands.

items.title: SD-PP-B1: post-sleep world_forward head change -> E3 ranking reach, route-attributed (rollout vs MECH-314a), yoked twins
items.note: SD-PP-B1 canonical-consumer probe commissioned by /governance (GFLAG-0413 option A, rec-20260923-e1e14f35; chip-20260923-sdppb1-consumer-probe). PREMISE CORRECTED before design (GFLAG-0437, REE_assembly 7d398c458c): e2.world_forward already reaches E3 by default via HippocampalModule -> E2.rollout_with_world (calls world_forward every step) -> E3 scores those world_states; so the probe is re-scoped to ROUTE ATTRIBUTION (rollout vs MECH-314a curiosity), 314a armed in all twins as commissioned. Design: yoked twins rebuilt from state_dicts, per-step identical RNG, env driven by twin A; DV = top-1 first-action-class change rate vs A at fresh E3 selects (ranking-shift, not behaviour); NULL twin exact-yoke gate; REINIT_BOTH / REINIT_CURIOSITY_ONLY positive controls; NOISE_MATCHED norm-matched context; alpha_world 0.9 (NOT the 0.3 default); done read in P0/held-out (no post-death collection). claim-free diagnostic (claim_ids []); Step 2.5d traced against driver criteria C1..C6: EVENT = force_cycle world-head change (smoke head rel-L2 0.044), DV = E3 argmin first-action class (smoke SLEEP_BOTH 0.059, REINIT 0.147, NULL 0.0 -- live, not inert). Step 2.4: decisive readout (counterfactual E3 ranking under a swapped world head) recorded in no manifest -> run. Step 2.5c degrading overlaps (non-blocking): e2-world-forward-sleep-trainer (implemented_pending_validation; smoke shows the sleep change DEGRADES held-out skill, delta -0.25 -- MECH-572 phenotype), SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX (hippocampal CEM), SD-091 (select_action coalition gate, off here), sd_epistemic_deficit_multitarget_readiness (314c, off here). DV-symmetry: every twin's DV is argmin/first-action-class (invariant to a uniform score shift); a head weight change moves each candidate's rollout world_states and 314a novelty separately, not uniformly -- REINIT twins confirm the manipulation class moves the DV. Smoke PASS (dry-run rc=0, 1 seed; not_ready label is the expected 1-seed <2 route). red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 4 fixed: twin E3-schedule desync via commit phase_reset now a per-twin determinacy gate with an undetermined label; C3 three-state + explicit route tokens; NOISE_MATCHED + near-tie + skill-delta recorded; C4 x4 demoted to recorded, non-finite ticks excluded. Known limit: E3 evaluators at P0 state (untrained), encoder untrained (SD-PP-B10 out of scope).

items.title: E3 channel-commensurability rung-3 validation at the ELIGIBILITY stage (per-channel knockout authority ratio vs OFF/ORACLE shadows) -- GFLAG-0297, substrate validation
items.note: GFLAG-0297 successor: E3 channel-commensurability rung-3 (f_dominance_conversion_ceiling / SD-E3-CHANNEL-COMMENSURABILITY) validated at the ELIGIBILITY stage -- NOT a MECH-439 test (non_contributory + evidence_direction_note + per-claim on every branch). WHY: V3-EXQ-1012a measured the PRIMARY-argmin flip rate with no gradable reference; V3-EXQ-1012b (label-permutation placebo) refused. Design record REE_assembly evidence/planning/gflag0297_mech439_rung3_null_design.md shows every primary-stage null is identity / knob-set / off-question, and 571c's landed manifest (same regime) shows shortlist active 100%, size 5-16 of k=32, final_commit_by_primary_frac 0.005-0.146 -- the operator reaches the executed action only via the RANGE-denominated margin-eligible set. DV: per live channel, tick-mean Jaccard distance between E(S) and E(S with that channel knocked out), over content ticks; R = min/max. Same-tick shadows ON (live), OFF (monopoly anchor, reported never gated), ORACLE (tick-local SD; decomposition anchor). C1 per regime: R_ON >= 0.25 in >= 3/4 seeds (MC anchor: 0.25 ~ 5x realised dominance). Can FAIL gate-green: sparse-LOW channel shape R~0.21 at perfect SD equalisation; sparse-HIGH at r>=3; channel >=5x its EMA. PRIOR stated: PASS expected under Gaussian/sparse-HIGH at r~1. Instrument gates: I1 residual live-vs-reconstructed (smoke max rel 1.06e-7), I1b replay self-check, I1c genuine OFF-replay cross-check, I2 float32 eligible-size match rate (smoke 0/28 mismatch). Verdict partition: instrument > per-regime {not_ready, moot, commensurate, ema_lag, shape_range}; PASS iff both regimes commensurate. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: no manifest records per-tick per-candidate per-channel terms (571c/1012a per-cell aggregates only) -> run. | Step 2.5b brake: MECH-439 braked for hypothesis re-tests; this is substrate validation on the measurement axis (the route the brake points to), as 1012a -> not braked, no ceiling hit added. | Step 2.5c: no open corrupting entry on the stage under test; runs under contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py ContextMemory.write, live, fix default-off) as a KNOWN LIMITATION -- upstream input, and the regime the conversion falsifiers run in (as 1012a/571c). Open degrading entries on exercised paths recorded, not blocking. | GFLAG-0072: support_preserving_min_first_action_classes kept at lineage 2 (P2 modulatory authority armed) -- the P1 ceiling binds class-entropy DVs, not candidate-level eligibility; raising it would break regime identity with 571c/1012a. | Substrate: SD-E3-CHANNEL-COMMENSURABILITY IMPLEMENTED ree-v3 c47b885; live-probed (knob reaches agent.e3.config; raw per-candidate terms captured per score_trajectory call; residual 1e-7). | Ethics: all-false/allow. | Smoke: dry-run PASS both cells (R_ON 0.56/0.82, R_OFF 0.00/0.04, R_ORACLE 0.79/0.75; all instrument gates 0 failures); validate_experiments --strict OK. | red-team (fable, run on the design spec before authoring): CONTESTED, 6 findings, all dispositioned: F1 identity instrument gate -> residual gate + replay self-check + OFF cross-check; F2 float32 cutoff -> torch-float32 reconstruction + rate gate; F3 grid -> partition with precedence; F4 PASS prior stated, shared content-tick set, shape + r_c(t) reported; F5 starved OFF gap corrected (4-25x), P1 kept at 2; F6 I3 recorded only. Step 3.5 review found one more: whole-run AND of arm gates -> per-regime not_ready class. | MECH-439's direction does not move on this record.
